messages:
Alex: Heads-up: draft launch post for Redwood Optimize is ready for embargoed preview next Tue at 9am PT. Need quick legal signoff, hero claim confirmation, webinar seat map, and inbound lead mapping. Who can triple-check today?
Maria: I can do a copy pass and CTA alignment today. Updated doc: https://docs.redwood/optimize-launch-draft (comments on).
Jamal: I'll validate the benchmark claim '~2.3x throughput' 35 and add a one-line citation to the internal run. Which run ID are we referencing?
Alex: Good catch. Use internal run 2025-11 (benchmark-run-113). Jamal, can you drop the exact phrasing we can cite?
Jamal: Pasted: "Internal eval (Nov 2025, benchmark-run-113) shows ~2.3x throughput vs baseline for 512-token average workloads; see methodology in appendix."
Sophia: Demo ops: propose three regional slots (Americas, EMEA, APAC). Suggest 50-attendee cap per slot, 45-min demo + 15-min Q&A. If we split, we should map registrants by timezone automatically.
Darren: For HubSpot import, we need CSV columns: email, first_name, last_name, region, product_interest, utm_campaign. Using utm_campaign: optimize_launch_q2. I'll drop the import template in 20m.
Leah: CTA split recommendation: 1) "Try Optimize 35 free" (trial funnel) and 2) "Request a demo 35 reserved" (sales funnel). For demo CTA include hidden field to capture Dedicated vs Hosted interest.
Maria: Added disclosure line under benchmarks: "Results may vary by workload; see methodology in appendix." Also added a short quantization caveat: "Benchmarks include mixed-precision runs; quantization profiles may affect throughput."
Alex: Legal, can we escalate? This is embargoed to press 35 need signoff by EOD tomorrow.
LegalBot: Marked priority. Standard quickpass ETA 24 hours, priority-legal ETA 6-8 hours. Please flag any third-party claims explicitly.
Jamal: One tiny edit: add parenthetical about dataset: "(internal synthetic load, 512-token avg; details in appendix)" so reviewers don't misinterpret.
Maria: Done. Also added UTMs to demo and try links: `?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=launch&utm_campaign=optimize_launch_q2`.
Sophia: Seat map: propose times 9am PT (Americas), 5pm CET (EMEA), 10pm JST (APAC). Each capped at 50. Will prepare registration routing that assigns timezone->slot and tags timezone and product interest.
Darren: HubSpot mapping note: map product_interest -> hs_product_interest, region -> hs_region, utm_campaign -> hs_campaign. I'll share CSV sample in the doc.
Leah: Anyone object to keeping the two-CTA structure? It simplifies funnel tracking.
Jamal: Fine with that. Also recommend a short appendix blurb about hardware used for benchmarks (GPU type, quantization level). Helps preempt technical questions.
Maria: Added a one-line hardware note and linked to the appendix doc.
Alex: Final checklist: legal priority signoff, Jamal phrasing inserted, Darren CSV template in doc, Sophia seat map/capacity. If all green, we schedule embargo publish Tue 9am PT. :thumbsup:
Maria: I'll ping channel once legal clears. :eyes:
